[i]This is an automated message.[/i]

Recently, a group called the NC (Nurdic Caliphate) attacked a village near the border in North Tartakum, killing 5 and injuring 14 after a year dormant. The Ministry Of Defence is sending out a small force to deal with these foes and send them back. They will send the ISC and a detachment of the Army.
[spoiler=
[b]ISC Mobilizes[/b]
[sub][/sub]]

The force will be consisted of 2 of the newly Acquired ZTZ-65's from Qianxun, 2 light IFV's from WMW company, a truck with a Reconnisance drone that can drop mortars, and 30 soldiers (Mounted on the ZTZ's, the 2 IFV's, and in a truck). The gear the soldiers are carrying is the newly Aquired MSR snipers and the Signal boosters for the support unit. They will have 3 snipers.

At 6:45 the force mobilizes, heading north towards the approximate area of the village.
At 7:00, they reach the checkpoint 20 minutes away from the village.
At 7:24, they reach the village finding it destroyed and deserted, still smoke from the fight that happened there. They deploy the UAV's, and spot militants in a small town 15 minutes away, with a ZSU.
At 7:50, the troops unload 5 minutes away, and the Snipers creep closer into a good position. The first shots are fired when the snipers pick off 2 Militants armed with Exported AK's, huddling near a sand bag because of the UAV above. At the same time, the UAV drops its first Mortar on another group of 2 militants, Incapacitating them. The ZSU starts firing fervorously at the UAV, but to no avail.
At 8:00, the UAV spots incoming exported BMD's to the town a few miles away. The ZTZ-65's go to intercept.
t 8:05, the first ZTZ-65 spots the one of the BMD's 4,000 meters away, and with surprising accuracy because of great Qianxun Development, the ZTZ-65 destroys the BMD with a shot to its side wall. The Second BMD comes into range and this time the second ZTZ-65 destroys it with a shot to its frontal armor. All the crew scramble out and prepare to engage infantry and armored targets. A nearby infantry unit deploys its Glopnir 4 missile (Fire and forget) and Incapacitates 2 of the Militants. One of the Militants pull out a RPG, and fire it towards the Infantry, unfortunately hitting one. The infantry unit prepares its LMG, and provides heavy support, picking off the other units
At 8:30, the IFV's have been barraging the town with Light Cannon fire and ATGMS. The roofs of the town are rubble and there are holes everywhere from shells. The ZTZ-65 and other Infantry unit are now back and are ready to assault. A fire team sets up on one of the roofs and feverishly fires at the Militants position. An fire team assaults a house, throwing a grenade, incapacitating one of the Militants. The Infantry units fight ally to ally, and miraculously only lose 1 man in the operation. One of the final moments of the battle was when a ZTZ-65 tank spotted a militant in an ally way, and guided by the UAV, launched a HEAT shell right down, combusting the ally way.
At 8:50, the last of the militants have either run away or been picked off. In total, 1 man has died and 3 soldiers have been injured.

The Ministry of Defence Is impressed by the ZTZ-65 tanks, and he takes note. He holds in high regard how well these old tanks performed, and he is perhaps thinking of acquiring more.

[/spoiler]

[nation]Qianxun[/nation]
